raster_policy.rule: Every experiment begins at raster 1. Rasters 1-4 may only use pre-window information and completed prior-run memory. Raster 5 alone reveals the current ten-day blind window. Raster 6 judges the completed run, stores lessons for future runs, measures learning progress and forces materially new exploration when research stagnates. Technical failures return the same run to raster 1 without consuming or changing the blind window. A valid MISS is durable learning evidence. A HIT at or above 200 is saved but does not stop holdout research.

ordered_rasters.purpose: Own technical health, checkpoints, deterministic repairs and subprocess timeouts. Preserve valid current-generation memory, return failed work to raster 1, and never choose trading hypotheses.

Use exactly the preceding 365 days and no current blind candles. Classify regime and enrich it with cross-asset breadth, dispersion, trend persistence, volatility and evidence strength so Raster 3 receives a contextual market state rather than a simple bull/bear label.

Generate materially different hypotheses from pre-window regime evidence plus completed run-level and trade-level memory. Learn contextually by regime, family, pair, entry tag, exit behavior and leverage. Preserve genuinely positive evidence, penalize repeated bad contexts, explore alternatives and never inspect the current blind window.

Challenge the candidate before blind reveal. Verify novelty, parameter-family consistency, hypothesis/regime consistency, zero look-ahead, and that any claimed signal evidence is actually backed by completed persistent memory. Reject duplicate or unsupported research claims and fake leverage.

Be the only raster that reveals the current untouched ten-day window. Execute from exactly 100 simulated capital with realistic configured fees, slippage proxy, borrowing proxy and liquidation accounting. Record per-trade evidence after execution; a valid MISS remains evidence rather than a technical failure.

Judge HIT only at >=200, checkpoint run and trade lessons for future windows, and perform meta-learning across recent completed runs. Measure HIT rate, balance distribution, improvement, zero-trade frequency and candidate diversity; detect stagnation and direct Raster 3 toward materially different hypotheses instead of endless parameter churn.

supervisor.name: TenDaySupervisor
supervisor.role: Final judge, checkpoint owner and learning-progress supervisor

promotion.rule: A run succeeds only when realized simulated capital reaches at least 200 within its blind ten-day window. A MISS remains valid learning evidence but never counts as success. One HIT is a milestone, not proof of repeatability.
